How do I create an account?: To get started, simply click “Start Free” on our homepage. You’ll be asked to enter your email and create a password—no credit card required. Once submitted, you’ll be taken directly to your dashboard where you can begin exploring the platform.
What should I do first after signing up?: After signing up, we recommend connecting your bank or payment accounts to begin syncing real-time financial data. Then, head over to your settings to adjust your currency, timezone, and preferences. You can also create your first invoice, set a budget, or explore the dashboard using the built-in walkthrough.
How do I connect my bank or payment tool: You can connect your financial tools by navigating to Settings → Integrations. Select your provider—like Stripe, PayPal, or your bank—and securely log in to authorize the connection. Once linked, your data will automatically begin syncing in real time.
Can I import financial data from other t: Yes. You can either upload CSV files directly into the platform or use our integrations with tools like QuickBooks, Xero, or Wave to automatically pull in your financial history. This helps you get started without losing your existing records.
How do I invite team members?: To invite team members, go to Settings → Team, enter their email addresses, and assign them a role such as Admin, Viewer, or Finance. They’ll receive an invitation immediately and can begin collaborating on your workspace.
Is there a tutorial or onboarding guide?: Yes. When you first log in, a guided product tour will walk you through the main features. If you ever want to revisit it, you can find it under Help → Product Tour inside your dashboard. It’s a great way to quickly get familiar with the platform.
How does the free trial work?: When you sign up, you’ll automatically start on a 7-day free trial of our Growth plan—no credit card required. During the trial, you get full access to all features included in the Growth plan. Once the trial ends, you can choose to upgrade or continue with the free Starter plan.
How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?: To change your plan, head to Settings → Billing, where you can view all available plans. From there, you can upgrade, downgrade, or switch between monthly and yearly billing with just a few clicks. Changes take effect immediately, and any prorated charges or credits will be applied automatically.
What happens when my free trial ends?: At the end of your 7-day trial, your account will automatically switch to the free Starter plan unless you choose to upgrade. All your data and progress will be saved, and you’ll still be able to use core features without interruption.
Can I cancel my subscription at any time: Yes, you can cancel your subscription whenever you like. Simply go to Settings → Billing and select the option to cancel. Your plan will remain active until the end of your current billing period, and no further charges will be made.
How do I access my invoices or receipts?: Invoices and payment receipts are always available in your Billing section. You can download them in PDF format for your records, reimbursements, or accounting needs.
Is my payment information secure?: Absolutely. We partner with industry-leading payment processors to ensure that your billing information is encrypted, securely stored, and never shared. Our platform is also fully PCI-compliant for added peace of mind.
What is the real-time dashboard and how: Your real-time dashboard gives you a live view of your financial health across all connected accounts. It updates automatically, so you can track income, expenses, cash flow, and key metrics without manual input. You can customize the layout, set your default views, and filter data based on time range, category, or account.
How do I create and manage a budget?: To start budgeting, go to the Budgets tab in your dashboard. You can create budgets by project, department, or category. Set your budget limit, assign owners or collaborators, and the system will track actual spend against your planned amount in real time. You’ll also receive alerts when you’re close to or exceeding your limits.
Can I automate invoices and payments?: Yes. You can set up recurring invoices, add payment links, and enable automatic reminders. From the Billing section, just choose the client, set the frequency, and personalize your invoice. Once sent, you’ll be able to track when it’s viewed, paid, or overdue—all from one place.
What types of financial reports are avai: The platform includes standard reports such as profit & loss, cash flow statements, and balance summaries. You can also build custom reports using filters like date, project, or transaction type. Reports update in real time and can be downloaded or shared directly with your team.
Is there a way to set financial goals?: Yes. Our Goals feature allows you to define targets for revenue, savings, or cost reduction. You’ll see visual progress indicators in your dashboard and receive insights on how to stay on track. This helps you plan with intention and adjust proactively.
How can I collaborate with my team?: You can invite team members under Settings → Team, and assign them different roles such as Admin, Viewer, or Finance. Team members can comment on reports, manage budgets, and work in real time without data conflicts. Permissions ensure sensitive data stays protected.
What tools can I integrate with the plat: You can connect a wide range of tools including Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, Xero, Wise, and various banks or financial services. We also support integrations with productivity platforms like Slack and Zapier, allowing you to automate notifications and workflows.
How do I set up an integration?: To get started, go to Settings → Integrations in your dashboard. From there, select the tool you want to connect, authorize access through a secure login, and the data sync will begin automatically. Most integrations take less than two minutes to complete.
How often is data synced with my connect: Data is synced in real time or near real time, depending on the platform. Financial transactions, balances, and activity logs are updated automatically so you’re always working with the most current data.
Can I disconnect or change an integratio: Yes. You can manage all your connected tools from the Integrations tab at any time. You can remove access, reconnect accounts, or add new services whenever your workflow changes—no disruption to your existing data.
Do you support custom integrations?: If you need more flexibility, we offer a public API that allows you to build custom connections between our platform and your own internal systems or third-party tools. You can find API documentation in the Developers section of our site.
Are integrations secure?: Absolutely. All integrations use encrypted connections and OAuth protocols where applicable. Your login credentials are never stored on our servers, and we follow strict data handling practices to protect your financial information.
How is my financial data protected?: We use bank-level encryption (256-bit SSL) to protect your data in transit and at rest. All connections to our platform are secured by HTTPS, and sensitive information is never stored in plain text. We also continuously monitor our systems to detect and prevent unauthorized access.
Are you compliant with global data prote: Yes. We’re fully compliant with GDPR and other major data protection regulations. We are committed to respecting your privacy, and you can request data access, correction, or deletion at any time through your account settings or by contacting our support team.
Do you store my bank login credentials?: No. Your login details are never stored on our servers. We use secure, third-party providers that are authorized to handle bank connections using industry-standard protocols like OAuth. This means we never see or retain your personal banking passwords.
Is two-factor authentication available?: Yes. For added security, we offer two-factor authentication (2FA) using email or an authenticator app. You can enable it in your account settings to add an extra layer of protection to your login process.
Who has access to my financial data?: Only you and authorized team members (based on their permission levels) have access to your account data. We never share your financial information with third parties without your consent, and internal access is strictly limited to key personnel for support and technical purposes only.
What should I do if I suspect suspicious: If you notice anything unusual in your account, contact our support team immediately via live chat or email. We’ll investigate the issue and take necessary action right away. You can also lock your account temporarily via the Security settings panel.
